title: Muscle Gate — Sports Nutrition & Supplements Platform
tagline: High-performance commercial e-commerce engineered for sports nutrition, featuring multi-attribute filtering, Upstash Redis caching, and bilingual AI search architecture.
description: A full-scale commercial web application built to serve sports nutrition athletes and bodybuilding enthusiasts. Designed with performance at its core, it features dynamic attribute filtering, in-memory caching to eliminate catalog latency, responsive stateful cart management, and automated order dispatch directly to customer service channels.
keyFeatures: Dynamic multi-attribute catalog filtering (Brand, Category, Price, Goals) with instant UI state updates
In-memory caching layer via Upstash Redis providing ultra-fast catalog and query response times
Resilient shopping cart state management with Zustand for seamless multi-device persistence
Automated order dispatch pipelines integrated with Telegram Bot and WhatsApp APIs
Structured bilingual JSON-LD Schema (OnlineStore, Product, FAQPage) engineered for Google Search & Generative AI engine discovery (GEO)

title: Al-Aseel — Premium Raw Honey & Natural Wellness
tagline: Fluid, interactive e-commerce store showcasing 130+ natural honey products with animated visual components, smooth carousel controls, and sub-second load times.
description: An artisanal e-commerce web application crafted for a luxury honey brand. Features an expansive catalog of over 130 SKUs, custom-engineered promotional animations, an interactive brand narrative walkthrough, and aggressive asset optimization delivering lightning-fast initial load times.
keyFeatures: Fast catalog pagination and multi-filter system (Origin, Health Benefit Tags, Price Range)
Interactive horizontal discount carousel and animated pendulum discount cards for promotional impact
Chapter-based brand story narrative with interactive visual storytelling
Secret growth modal triggered with shortcut keys for direct business & wholesale inquiries
Aggressive media optimization pipeline compressing assets by 84% without visual degradation
